seed_rule: 20260922 + scene index in frozen manifest order
primary_metric: minimum of three active-reference-mask SI-SDR improvements per scene in evaluation band

statistics.bootstrap_scheme: resample 10 scenes within each stratum, concatenate to 30; preserve stratum counts
statistics.unplanned_silent_or_invalid_source: failed scene; no replacement or denominator removal
statistics.decision: Thresholds apply to preregistered primary only; secondary cannot rescue failed primary. Report strata descriptively; bootstrap is conditional on selected corpus, not population proof.

activity_policy: ActivityConfig defaults frozen by ADR0008/0009; mask before final gain; filter before mask; identical masks for methods
limits: given DOA, far-field, no room reverberation
no hardware, automatic localization or fixed-point claim
selection_basis: Primary 512 balances previously observed development results and shorter buffering; 1024 retained as prespecified secondary. No holdout algorithm scores inspected.
